If the markings differ, the wheels have been changed, or you are unsure, contact RoadRunner support before ordering with clear photos of both tire sidewalls and the rim, your scooter serial number and original purchase date. This notice does not establish compatibility for this tire with every RS5.

85/65-6.5 and 90/65-6.5 are different tire sizes. Do not assume they are interchangeable. Confirm the appropriate tire for your actual wheel before substituting a different size.
